- tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_step_scripts_contract.py:420-423 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The assertion splits the wait-review step text after `source "${STABLE_E2E_STEP_SCRIPT}"` and expects the run IDs there. The IDs live in the Phase 4d comment block at lines 2169-2179, which `_e2e_steps` rolls into the wait-review chunk because it splits only on `      - name: `.
  WHY: Moving the Phase 4d comment or refactoring `_e2e_steps` makes the test fail with a misleading "wait-review is missing run ids" message.
TASK_GAP:
Requirement: "In `scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh`... print... the job statuses of each non-completed review run." The intent is that a Phase 4 timeout log lists jobs for every non-completed review run, so runner starvation can be told apart from a concurrency hold.
Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, "Phase 4d: Review-timeout run inventory" step, lines 2216-2218 (the `TIMEOUT_INV_JOB_FETCHES -ge 5` cap) and the loop body at lines 2211-2234.
Evidence of absence: Lines 2211 and 2216-2218 cap the jobs lookup at 5. After that the loop prints only the run-level line and "  (job lookup skipped: cap of 5 reached)", so runs 6..N have no job status. `test_review_timeout_inventory_body_runs_with_stubbed_gh` at lines 552-557 locks in the cap (`len([c for c in calls if "/jobs" in c]) == 5`, `out.count("(job lookup skipped: cap of 5 reached)") == 2`).
SEVERITY: NIT
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

- tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_step_scripts_contract.py:420-423 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The test attributes the run IDs to the wait-review step. The IDs live only in the Phase 4d comment block (workflow lines 2169-2179), and `_e2e_steps` (lines 50-64) splits chunks at '\n(?=      - name: )', so the comment lines bleed into the wait-review chunk.
  WHY: This is a test-maintenance hazard, not a product-runtime failure. Moving the comment, renaming the step or reordering the steps makes the assertion fail with a misleading wait-review attribution.
TASK_GAP:
Requirement: Issue #9418 suggested fix 1 asks the timeout path to print "plus the job statuses of each non-completed review run."
Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, Phase 4d review-timeout inventory step
Evidence of absence: Lines 2216-2218 cap job-detail fetches at 5 (TIMEOUT_INV_JOB_FETCHES >= 5). Beyond the cap the step prints "(job lookup skipped: cap of 5 reached)" and continues, so with more than 5 non-completed runs (the runs list allows per_page=20) their job statuses are omitted. The run-level status line still prints for every run. The cap is a deliberate, documented API-hygiene tradeoff ("at most 5 jobs calls (§14)"), so this is a partial deviation only.
SEVERITY: NIT
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
